name: Natsukawa Midori
source:
Natsumi is the "summer Grace". [Spoiler]She's the first person Mitsuki thinks she has "broken" and "defiled".[/spoiler]

One summer day, Natsumi stole a hairpin from a store and [Spoiler]Mitsuki[/spoiler] started blackmailing her. Natsumi is unable to fight back in the open, so she uses dark magic to put a hex on her oppressor. 

She's very indecisive and afraid of making a "bad impression". Her parents dreamed of a perfect, intelligent daughter, and Natsumi worries that she won't be able to live up to their expectations.

People are drawn to Natsumi [Spoiler]at first, but after not feeling the inner strength in her they begin to feel uncomfortable.[/spoiler]

Natsumi loves playing computer games. She would spend hours on end playing them. She likes RPGs and quests the most, visual novels the least. 

[i]"You won't leave me alone, huh? Right, [Spoiler]Mitsuki[/spoiler]?"[/i]

[Based on the [Url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3753200]official art-book[/url]]
